The '''2005–06''' season of the Belgian [[Belgian First Division A|Jupiler League]] began on August 5, 2005 and ended on May 5, 2006.  [[RSC Anderlecht|Anderlecht]] won the title on the last day of competition.

These teams were promoted from the [[Belgian Second Division|second division]] at the start of the season:
*[[S.V. Zulte-Waregem]] (second division champion)
*[[K.S.V. Roeselare]] (playoff winner)

==Relegated teams==
This team was relegated to the second division at the end of the season:
*[[R.A.A. Louviéroise]]
